mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, which positively impacts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of the periods following a sustained decrease in FEDFUNDS over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where both HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month, combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of the periods following a sustained increase in GDPC1 over two consecutive quarters.
